answers.question: Which platforms have stairs/lifts?
answers.answer: Both platforms: platform 1 (track 1, by the station building, also reached directly through the building's platform doors) and the island platform for tracks 2–3 each have stairs and a lift down to the Asematunneli. VR confirms a lift to the platforms; positions are OSM.
answers._source: VR 'Oulu' station page, https://www.vr.fi/rautatieasemat-ja-reitit/oulu, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_fi/FI-OL.json), read 2026-10-30
